traits.name: Mimicry.
traits.text: The kenku can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations only with a successful DC 14 Investigation check.

actions.name: Shortsword.
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow.
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.
